title: booking_trackingno_push
label: SHOPEE · PUSH MECHANISM
subtitle: Get notified immediately when booking tracking numbers are updated so that you can ship promptly, and avoid having to query the v2.logistics.get_booking_tracking_number API repeatedly. This can be useful when logistics partners take some time to update tracking numbers which may be required on shipping documents.
